description: One organization's IRS record: exempt status, 501(c) subsection, NTEE category, ruling year, deductibility (Publication 78), fiscal year end, which return it files, last filing, and the latest e-filed financial summary. Optional sections: financials (up to 5 years of revenue, expenses, assets from e-filed Form 990/990-EZ/990-PF), officers (up to 15 officers, directors and key employees with compensation from the latest e-filed return), filing_history (e-Postcards and e-filed returns).
